title: 第015章 妒邪幡然归正道，梦元温灵愈倦身
content_zh:
“蔡小姬，别怪我狠心啦，这都是你自找的！”

    “抢尽我的风头，夺走本该属于我的机缘，今日就让你葬身在此！”

    蔡文龙低声嘶吼，内心的嫉妒已经彻底吞噬了理智。

    隘口中央，乱石呼啸而下，毒箭破空而来，危机近在咫尺。

    若是换做普通外门弟子，此刻早已惊慌失措，要么慌忙躲闪，要么仓促运转灵气抵挡，难免会出现纰漏。

    可蔡文姬身经峡谷无数团战突袭，应对这种伏击早已形成本能。

    她脚步轻点地面，身形如同风中柳絮，在密集的乱石间隙里轻巧腾挪。

    看似缓慢，却每一步都精准避开砸落的石块。

    同时心念一动，【胡笳乐】骤然释放！

    无形音波在空中炸开，接连弹射，不仅将迎面而来的数支毒箭尽数震偏、击落。

    音波余势更是顺着箭支飞行的轨迹，反向冲入两侧密林之中。

    “加油喔文姬！打他屁屁啦！”梦奇在肩头挥舞着小爪子呐喊。

    嗖嗖几声轻响，原本躲在暗处准备伺机而动的蔡文龙，瞬间被音波精准命中。

    眩晕禁锢效果当场触发！

    蔡文龙保持着拉弓瞄准的姿势，整个人僵在密林之间，手脚无法动弹，声带也被音波锁住，连惊呼都发不出来。

    他眼神不甘，满脸难以置信。

    怎么可能？！

    落石、毒箭双重伏击，居然被对方如此轻松化解？

    甚至连躲在暗处的自己，都被一击控住？

    这诡异的音波法术，竟然强悍到了这种地步？

    慌乱之间，头顶滚落的碎石还在不断下坠，有几块巨石失去牵制，直直朝着蔡文龙藏身的位置砸去！

    他被定在原地，眼睁睁看着巨石呼啸而来，心底涌起极致的恐惧与绝望！

    蔡文姬站在隘口中央，抬头看了一眼密林里动弹不得的堂哥，轻轻摇了摇头。

    “不作不死！害人终会害己。”
content_en:
"Cai Xiaoji, don't blame me for being cruel, you brought this on yourself!"

    "Steal my limelight, take away the opportunity that should belong to me, and I will let you die here today!"

    Cai Wenlong roared in a low voice, the jealousy in his heart had completely swallowed up his reason.

    In the center of the pass, rocks roared down, poisonous arrows shot through the air, and the crisis was close at hand.

    If it were an ordinary outer sect disciple, he would already be panicking at this moment. He would either dodge in a hurry or use his spiritual energy to resist in a hurry. Mistakes would inevitably occur.

    But Cai Wenji has experienced countless team battles and raids in the canyon, and she has already developed an instinct for dealing with such ambushes.

    Her footsteps touched the ground lightly, and her figure was like catkins in the wind, moving lightly among the dense rocks.

    It seems slow, but every step accurately avoids falling rocks.

    At the same time, with a thought in my mind, [Hu Jia Le] was suddenly released!

    Invisible sound waves exploded in the air and bounced off one after another, deflecting and shooting down all the poisonous arrows coming towards them.

    The sound waves followed the arrow's flight trajectory and rushed into the dense forests on both sides.

    "Come on Wenji! Span him!" Mengqi shouted, waving her little paws on her shoulders.

    There were a few soft whoosh sounds, and Cai Wenlong, who was hiding in the dark and waiting for an opportunity, was instantly hit accurately by the sound wave.

    The stun and imprisonment effect is triggered on the spot!

    Cai Wenlong maintained the posture of drawing the bow and taking aim. He was frozen in the dense forest, unable to move his hands and feet. His vocal cords were also locked by sound waves, and he could not even utter a exclamation.

    His eyes were filled with disbelief.

    How is that possible? !

    The double ambush of falling rocks and poisonous arrows was resolved so easily by the opponent?

    Even himself who was hiding in the dark was controlled by one blow?

    Is this weird sonic spell so powerful?

    In the panic, the gravel rolling down from above continued to fall. Several huge rocks lost control and hit Cai Wenlong's hiding place!

    He was frozen in place, watching helplessly as the boulders roared towards him, feeling extreme fear and despair well up in his heart!

    Cai Wenji stood in the middle of the pass, looked up at her cousin who was unable to move in the dense forest, and shook her head slightly.

    "If you don't do it, you will die! If you harm others, you will eventually harm yourself."
title_en: Chapter 015 Jealousy returns to the right path, Mengyuan Wenling becomes more tired
